'''Stavas''' was<ref name="SWTOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They served the Empire as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] on<ref name="SWTOR" /> the Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]&mdash;working from a [[Tent/Legends|tent]] near the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], selling light [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Stavas had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. While at their stall, Stavas wore a gray Imperial uniform and a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stavas first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he acted as a light armor vendor on Korriban.<ref name="SWTOR" />
